test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-3) Official Paper (Held On: 17 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

I. All keys are locks.

II. Some locks are doors.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some doors are keys.

II. Some doors are locks.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows

solution:
The least possible Venn diagram of given statements can be drawn as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d1a1de5c011e25ba4c8a6b6fafb7f4aa5716a952f5801d2318118d58c62d4071.png] 

**__Conclusion:__**

I. **Some doors are keys ⇒ Not Follows**. Their is a relation given between doors and locks & locks and keys but not for keys and doors so no solid conclusion can be drawn for some doors are keys. 

II. **Some doors are locks ⇒ Follows **. Some doors are locks can be also written as some locks are doors which is the statement II.

Hence,** Only conclusion II follows.**
